sloka: तवादर्शनजः शोको भूयो मां परितापयेत् ।दुःखाद्दुःखपराभूतां दुर्गतां दुःखभागिनीम् ।। ५.६८.६ ।।।।
transliteration: tavādarśanajaḥ śoko bhūyo māṁ paritāpayet ।duḥkhādduḥkhaparābhūtāṁ durgatāṁ duḥkhabhāginīm ।। 5.68.6 ।।।।

translations.english: I am an unfortunate one, afflicted by sorrow and tormented (by demons). If I am not able to see you I will be lamenting in grief.
